title: Jags OK'd to play 2027 home games in Orlando

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Jags OK'd to play 2027 home games in Orlando
sources.description: The Jaguars' proposal to play their home games in the 2027 season in Orlando, Florida, during the final year of the $1.4 billion renovation of EverBank Stadium was unanimously approved by the NFL's owners Tuesday.
